description: Rerank: does one section of a document answer or bear on a question? Asked per section, section text in the state (items.<id>), question in the instruction.
instructions: Does {item} contain information that answers, or directly bears on, this question: "{question}"
output: tools/jev_sections.py: ranks the BM25 shortlist; the top-k sections are returned verbatim with offsets and p (Researcher reads them instead of whole documents).
